channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: The blockchain network added new pattern mapping and phase plans, durability checks were added to storage, and the SDK introduced role overrides and testing; a template project updated its third‑party resolution. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: The blockchain network refined its plans and recorded execution details, while storage handling tests were updated. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: The wallet added temporary diagnostic prints and improved verification diagnostics. Repositories: GeniusWallet.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: The blockchain roadmap was documented with new phases and storage backup notes were rewritten. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An outdated submodule was removed from the cognitive system, and the blockchain network updated its storage backup and cold‑storage handling. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor scenario tools added new lockout scenarios and fixed value formatting, while the SDK introduced a payout address function and switched to self‑hosted runners; a third‑party component was updated and a numeric keypad input was added to a scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, libp2p.
